population: Hypothetical itch.io publisher offering either playable HTML5 or downloadable Linux game, optional free demo and distinct positive-price full-game entitlement
unit: Required QA check or documented store feature, not a measured game or paid sale
period: Creator, app, and butler documentation available October 26 2026
sample_frame: Official HTML5, Linux integration, butler push, project pricing and download-key documentation

checks.question: Do index.html and all relative resources load in the deployed CDN case-sensitive paths?
Do canvas and UI adapt to advertised desktop and mobile viewport sizes?
Does audio unlock correctly after the browser user gesture?
Do keyboard/gamepad controls work and recover focus across fullscreen and tab switching?
If Mobile Friendly is checked, do touch targets, orientation and gestures support full play?
Do browser state and saves survive reload, update and expected storage limits?
Does the shipped content load within the declared budget on supported connections and devices?
Does the build avoid publishing unnecessary player identifiers or requesting unrelated access?

tests.question: Does executable launch cleanly on an older supported distribution with correct architecture?
Does unpacking preserve executable permissions and expected relative paths?
Do required shared libraries resolve without bundling drivers or unsuitable runtime libraries?
Do advertised keyboard/controller bindings work without privileged device access?
Are saves stored in a writable appropriate user location and survive update?
Does the downloaded game work offline if the listing advertises offline support?
Do clean installation, patch and unchanged user saves work together?

validation_checks.question: Can an unpurchased user get only the declared free demo and no priced full build?
Can an authorized paid tester access paid full files including correct OS channel?
Does individually-priced soundtrack or bonus material require a sufficient associated key price?
Does separate demo and full game preserve compatible saves only where explicitly promised?
Are demo, beta and production versions unmistakably labeled?

limits: Source-backed packaging requirements are not evidence that any particular game runs correctly.
Linux executable dependencies, archives and mobile browser input require observed on-device tests, not only manifest inspection.
A free demo, page view, HTML5 play or manually issued key is not a positive-price paid order.
itch.io update mechanisms do not guarantee that every incompatible patch can be automatically rolled back or that user saves are preserved.
The HTML5 view and a separate positively-priced downloadable build have different entitlement and payment models.
Actual QA duration, bandwidth saved, compatibility failure rates and incremental paid sales remain unobserved.
